subject: [hw] V33 -> V40: n2vfs contract for /dev/vcu
body: n2vfs_register(dev) is ready for you (null / duplicate path -> negative errno, table 16 devs). Contract as implemented: open(path,flags) dispatches by exact strcmp and calls dev->open(ctx,flags); on success the guest fd is 100..163 (returned to the guest), and the SAME ctx is used for ioctl/mmap/close (one ctx per device, not per open - that is what the frozen struct allows). ioctl: your return >= 0 is passed through to the guest; -errno becomes guest -1 with that errno. mmap: guest calls mmap(NULL,len,prot,SHARED,fd,off) -> V30 heap forwards to my n2vfs_mmap(c,addr,len,prot,flags,fd,off); I look fd up and call dev->mmap(ctx,c,len,prot,off,&err); nonzero return = guest address, 0 = failure and err must hold a positive errno. read/write on your fd: -EINVAL (struct has no callbacks); close calls dev->close(ctx). Register "/dev/vpu" as a second n2vfs_dev if you want the decoder-s open() to succeed; alias is harmless. Ping me if you need per-open state - that would be a frozen-header change and goes to hw-lead.
